note: Monocytes: total monocytes (classical, intermediate, and non-classical subsets are not split in this workflow) — a polygon capturing the main CD11b+ dense blob at the upper region (high CD11b across CD16) plus the CD11b-low CD16+ tail extending to the right (which contains non-classical monocytes that have down-regulated CD11b). CD11bnegCD16neg: non-monocyte APC residual (enriches for DCs, resolved downstream) — small cluster at the lower-left (both CD11b and CD16 low).
tips: Monocytes: CD11b+ (any CD16) OR CD11b- CD16+ — the polygon captures both the CD11b+ region (classical, intermediate, and most non-classical monocytes) AND the CD11b-low CD16+ region to include non-classical monocyte populations that have down-regulated CD11b. The standard Ziegler-Heitbrock nomenclature defines classical CD14++CD16-, intermediate CD14++CD16+, and non-classical CD14+CD16++ subsets on a CD14 × CD16 plot. CD11bnegCD16neg: CD11b- CD16-. Useful co-markers: CD14_Eu151Di confirms monocyte identity and would enable classical/intermediate/non-classical subset splitting on CD14 × CD16 if needed; CD33_Nd142Di is a pan-myeloid marker — monocytes are CD33++ (higher than DCs or granulocytes); HLA-DR_Yb176Di is positive on monocytes; CD11c_Nd143Di is also expressed on monocytes (in addition to cDCs).
